retirement.scope: Exact bound-RM allocation records only; generic Session release/unmap retain their IRQ guards.
retirement.logical_unmap: Revoke caller DMA token while retaining its exact backend map, IOVA and physical backing until actual interrupt drain.
retirement.logical_free: Revoke new CPU/DMA access; preserve existing CPU aliases until last close; keep backend ownership in a non-reusable retirement record.
retirement.remap: Same physical backing and retained IOVA only, after current provider/mapper/no-bounce revalidation.
retirement.drain: NV_STATUS drainRmRetirements(Session *); requires successful actual IRQ drain and records backend completion progress per allocation.
retirement.full_rm_capacity_sufficiency: not_established; firmware/log/GPU configuration and boot retry affect peak ownership

dma_remap_policy.original_semantics: Inverse of nv_dma_maps_swiotlb for the bound device; selects explicit DMA mapping of CPU physical PTEs, not IOMMU presence.
dma_remap_policy.provider_attestation: Retained published device IOMapper for the opened PCI provider, or real kBypassed factory acceptance with the same retained published live Platform Expert and no platform/provider mapper properties. Revalidated at each query and mapping boundary.
dma_remap_policy.direct_actual_commands: IODMACommand::kBypassed; per-page CPU physical identity; never kUnmapped
dma_remap_policy.direct_factory_bound: Normal single published Platform Expert boot lifecycle only; no concurrent PE restart/replacement or external mapper-policy writers. Unknown/required refuse before factory; raw null only guards waiting and never admits policy.
dma_remap_policy.scalar_unavailable_policy: entry-must-be-blocked-before-call; non-returning contract violation if called without an attested bound policy
